## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `.env.test` not read — a PreToolUse secret-read hook blocks reading it; its presence and git tracking were verified, and the documented local `DATABASE_URL` server (`localhost:5432`, role `tasks`) was used. Gates ran with `DATABASE_URL` pointed at the ephemeral DB.
- No host `psql` — DB admin and assertions used `docker exec task-api-db-1 psql` against the same server.
- Ephemeral DB name keeps the run-id byte-for-byte (`eval_f05_2026-11-23T15-25-29Z`, quoted identifier).
- Service logs: the constrained instance logged one expected `WARN database unavailable: pool timed out while waiting for an open connection` (API-REJECT-01); no `ERROR` lines on either instance; no SQL or internal detail in any response body.
